**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What exists:** Section 9 "TRUELINK WARRANTIES" (p0059–p0060) is limited to a Y2K date-processing warranty. Hosting Services (§3) and Support Services (§4) are "reasonable commercial efforts" undertakings only, and §2's licence grant carries no conformance warranty. No repair/replace/refund remedy appears anywhere.
- **Why it fails fallback:** none of the four fallback elements (90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day services warranty, repair or replacement, refund) is present. The blanket disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so it does not swallow express warranties and needed no edit.
- **Cure:** a single short insertion after p0060 adding the fallback warranty (90 days software / 30 days services) with repair, replacement or refund of fees paid at Client's election — no survival tail, no preferred-level 12-month uplift, and no rewriting of the retained Y2K language.
